summary: GDS Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing the release of its 2025 Sustainability Report, which includes updates on decarbonization, renewable energy usage, PUE improvement, and an MSCI ESG rating upgrade to AAA. The filing contains no transactional or special-situation content such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or strategic reviews. It is a routine sustainability disclosure by a foreign private issuer. No deal terms, prices, premiums, or shareholder actions are mentioned. This is a standard ESG reporting update with no event-driven implications.
